translations.title: Vitamin B1, B2, B6 and C Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1, B2, B6 and C when you are physically tired or your strength is low, for neuralgia, muscle pain and joint pain, for angular cheilitis, cheilitis, mouth sores and glossitis, for beriberi and eye fatigue, to relieve pigmentation, and to help prevent bleeding gums and nose.
translations.usage: Children aged 8 years and over and adults take one tablet twice a day, in the morning and evening.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive to it or are a baby under 3 months old. Talk to a pharmacist if you have gout, kidney stones or folate deficiency, or are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 colouring. Do not take it together with levodopa.

summaryTable.Ingredient: Vitamins B1, B2, B6 and C
summaryTable.How it works: Supplies B-group vitamins and vitamin C
summaryTable.Who should be careful: People with gout or kidney stones, or taking levodopa
summaryTable.Why this one: A B-group and vitamin C combination tablet
